assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an original production pixel-art spaceship support module sprite for a 360-degree top-down mobile sci-fi survivor game. Primary request: draw ONE isolated compact hull-repair pod with a bright mint-green medical plus on its central capsule and TWO visibly opened articulated repair arms extending diagonally left and right. This object restores the player's hull, so the arms end in tiny mint welding tips, not guns. Top-down orthographic view, forward direction straight up. Body is a short rounded rectangular capsule, squat and clearly different from a triangular attack drone. Arms form a shallow U around the capsule, ending slightly ahead of the body. A small gold hinge on each side and a short dark-purple connector at the rear. Style: carefully hand-pixelled sprite using a coherent native 28x24-pixel design enlarged with exact crisp square pixels. Restrained medium-detail pixel art. No antialiasing. No gradients. Materials: purple-gray armor #393449, #57516d, #9a92ad with sparse ivory upper-left highlights. Muted brass hinges #bd8a51 and #f4c57a. Mint green repair illumination #84d7b0 and pale mint #c1f4cf. Deep navy outline #17172b. Lighting upper-left. Composition: entire module centered, ample completely transparent empty space around all edges, no contact with image bounds. Transparent background, true alpha. No background grid, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no floor, no shadow disc, no bloom beyond the silhouette. No text, labels, letters, watermark, or UI frame. No missile pods, barrels, missiles, wings, decorative stars, extra objects, or player spaceship.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original pixel art HUD inventory icon, a tiny spaceship hull-repair pod. Icon is a squat purple-gray armored capsule with one large luminous mint-green medical plus centered on its face. A small muted-gold bracket on each side, tiny ivory upper-left armor highlights, and two short folded tool arms tucked alongside the capsule. No wings, guns, missiles, flying ship, text, outline badge, or enclosing UI frame. Native design must be cleanly readable as 24x24 game pixels enlarged to big crisp square pixels, restrained medium-detail 1990s sci-fi pixel art. Top down orthographic, forward up. Palette: navy #17172b outline, purple-gray #393449 #57516d #9a92ad armor, ivory #f3e8e1 highlights, muted brass #bd8a51 #f4c57a hinges, mint #84d7b0 and pale mint #c1f4cf large central plus. Entire object centered with generous empty transparent margin around all edges. Genuine transparent alpha background. No painted checkerboard, backdrop, floor, drop shadow, bloom, antialiasing, gradient, lettering, stars, sparkles, text, watermark or other objects. Strong central medical-plus silhouette, simple tool-pod identity, 24-pixel visual scale, all important details need to survive reduction.
